intro: The Marshall Islands is a parliamentary republic in free association with the United States.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament, the Nitijela, elects the president. Hilda Heine was the first woman president, in 2016 and again from 2024. A Council of Iroij (chiefs) advises on custom.

chapters.title: The Compact
text: The US provides funds and defence and keeps a missile test range at Kwajalein.

keyTerms.meaning: Independence with a close agreement with the US.
